No frozen artifact states whether a probability equal to the threshold predicts positive. With candidates drawn from the observed values this choice changes the confusion counts.
The frozen record names 'F2' but never states beta or a formula.
No frozen artifact defines the degenerate case.

rejected_implementation.note: Its ascending scan keeps the first, and therefore lowest, maximizing candidate, while the locked tie-break requires the highest. It also builds a 200-point linear grid unioned with synthetic 0.0/1.0 endpoints, none of which any contract fixes.
